description: Fixed work areas for work:guard. One area = one user-facing behavior or shared capability. Add an area only with a reason in the active plan; never invent one for a single task.

areas.conversation-orchestration: Conversation state, intent interpretation, confirmation gates, revise/generate routing
areas.director-draft: Director draft generation, prompts and structured fields
areas.video-confirmation: Draft confirmation, video_project_ready, duplicate confirmation and recovery
areas.video-render: Render jobs, MG overlay, final video export
areas.video-clarity: Video clarity review, enhancement suggestions and before/after comparison
areas.subtitle: Subtitle generation, editing and burn-in
areas.source-video: Uploaded source videos: ingest, naming, storyboarding and repurposing
areas.asset-library: Library UI, upload, categories and asset references
areas.asset-understanding: Asset understanding, metadata.understanding, document image extraction
areas.workspace-shell: Workbench navigation, layout, global styles and the video preview shell
areas.release-deploy: Deployment, release verification, CI and git hooks
areas.workspace-governance: Rule files, guard scripts and authority document structure
